_comment: The seven fixed render formats for graphics-studio. Each: {canvas{w,h}, multi_slide, density_rules, content_schema}. The agent authors HTML to canvas size honoring density_rules and filling content_schema; render.mjs screenshots at deviceScaleFactor 2. Map any community/odd size to one of these before rendering. multi_slide formats render a directory of per-slide HTML files to one PNG each.

carousel.density_rules: Cover hook slide; one idea per content slide (max 3-4 list items each); CTA close slide. Keep type large; safe inner margins 96px.

story.density_rules: One bold message, very large type, keep content in the central 1080x1420 safe zone (top/bottom 250px reserved for platform UI).

infographic.use: Tall infographic / data story (full-page capture; height grows to content)
infographic.density_rules: Sectioned vertical flow; one stat or step per band; numbered steps; strong hierarchy; consistent section spacing. Height is a hint — full-page capture grows to fit.

slides.density_rules: One idea per slide, max ~6 bullets/cards, single viewport (no scroll), big title + supporting visual.

poster.density_rules: One headline + supporting line + brand mark. High contrast, oversized type, lots of breathing room.

chart.density_rules: One chart, titled, labeled axes, source line. Legible numbers; one clear takeaway annotated.

tweet.density_rules: One punchy statement or code/screenshot mock; legible at small size; strong contrast; signature/handle in a corner.
